segments.sn35.3:1.2: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.3:1.3: Sotaṃ anattā … pe … ghānaṃ anattā … jivhā anattā … kāyo anattā … mano anattā.
segments.sn35.3:1.8: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.3:1.9: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
